survivors.claim: `appendDerivedPicksToBrief` silently returns (no die, no printed line) when brief.md has no `## Picks` heading, so on such a brief the MENUS step prints the three `📌 Auto-picked` lines while recording nothing — the D6(b) record is skipped without telling the session why. Practical blast radius is small because `--mark menus-done` (line 567) independently dies on a missing `- archetype:` Picks line, forcing the session to add the section and re-run bare, at which point the append lands; but the no-op itself is a silent skip rather than a named remedy.
survivors.impact: A brief missing its picks section gets told the frontend was auto-picked but nothing is written, and the driver never says so.
survivors.evidence: genesis-driver.js:363-378: `const m = headingRe.exec(text); if (!m) return` with no message; `handleBriefWritten` (lines 739-760) validates discovery-done and the mocks status/ledger only — no `## Picks` section check (grep for a section requirement returned nothing). The template spec/templates/genesis-brief.md:32 does carry `## Picks`, so the path is only reachable on a hand-edited brief. Not executed as a repro; advisory only.
